There have long been rumours that Apple is preparing a major overhaul of its Home product line, and the latest leaked data reveals a series of upcoming products.

macOS Code Leak Mentions Several Unreleased Home Devices

Apple's biggest annual launch event is just weeks away. In addition to the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, and the next-generation Apple Watch, it is also expected that brand-new Home products will make their debut.

Among the rumoured upcoming products are the next-generation Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad. However, other Home products may also be released in the short term.

Yesterday, MacRumors discovered that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC version contains information related to several unreleased products.

These include codenames tied to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be the home hub version that comes with a stand, while J491 is the version designed for wall-mounted installation."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini's codename is B520, so B525 is believed to be the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Very likely the rumoured security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Unknown Home devices appearing for the first time.
  • ATVRemote1,5: The next-generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robot-style home hub. It is not yet confirmed whether their codenames also appear in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Apart from products, MacRumors also discovered a codename called "Pebble", believed to be the internal name for homeOS. In addition, there is a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning", which may be related to HomePad.

Finally, the data also shows four colours for an unspecified Home accessory: Rose, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
